scripts.title: [FE] Spider-Man Script V1.0.5 (UPDATED)
scripts.features:
Minor updates.

Changelogs V1.0.5:
- When you jump and land now your character will do a Spiderman style pose.
- When you press Z while standing still then your character will do the Superhero emote. (Spiderman Backflip)

Bare in mind it's only version 1 so there will be bugs and what not, certain games may also have it be bannable so use at your own risk. Also there's no suit up option as of right now.

Controls:
Wall Climb - Go up to any wall and press X against the wall and you'll enter climb mode. Either press X again to stop or reach the top (based on how many parts the wall has). Very simple and looks cool since it's got an animation to go with it when climbing. People find it cool especially if you're dressed as Spider-Man.

Web Swing - Aim your mouse anywhere and hold Q and click, it's got a cool little animation while swinging too. There's no actual web (yet) because I don't really have any idea on how to make it possible in FE but hopefully there will be one in future.

If you guys enjoy it I'll be happy to update and continue working on it. Have fun and thanks for sticking with me :)

Preview: https://imgur.com/C03KXGL (OLD)

			Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + Delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + Delta.Y)
			game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(Frame, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Position = Position}):Play()

					end

		Frame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

				dragInput = input
			end
		end)
		game:GetService("UserInputService").InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if input == dragInput and dragToggle then

			end
		end)

    local nameEsp = Drawing.new("Text"); nameEsp.Text = tostring(animal); nameEsp.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255); nameEsp.Center = true; nameEsp.Outline = true; nameEsp.OutlineColor = Color3.new(0,0,0); nameEsp.Font = 0

    RenderStepped = game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if table.find(blacklistNames, tostring(animal.Name)) then nameEsp.Visible = false; healthEsp.Visible = false return end
        if animalHealth.Value <= 0 then nameEsp.Visible = false; healthEsp.Visible = false return end
        healthEsp.Text = tostring(math.ceil(animalHealth.Value))
        local animalPos, onScreen = game:GetService("Workspace").CurrentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(animal.Body.CFrame.Position)
        if onScreen then
            noerror = pcall(function()
                if animalHealth.Value > animalMaxHP[tostring(animal.Name)] * 0.66 then
                    healthEsp.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
                elseif animalHealth.Value > animalMaxHP[tostring(animal.Name)] * 0.33 then
                    healthEsp.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)
                else
                    healthEsp.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
                end
                nameEsp.Position = Vector2.new(animalPos.X, animalPos.Y - 25)
                healthEsp.Position = nameEsp.Position + Vector2.new(0, -15)
                nameEsp.Size = 1000 / animalPos.Z + 15
                healthEsp.Size = nameEsp.Size
                nameEsp.Visible = true
                healthEsp.Visible = true
            end)
        else
            nameEsp.Visible = false
            healthEsp.Visible = false
        end
    end)
    local ChildRemoved
    ChildRemoved = game:GetService("Workspace")["WORKSPACE_Entities"].Animals.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
        if child == animal then
            nameEsp:Remove()
            healthEsp:Remove()
            RenderStepped:Disconnect()

            ChildRemoved:Disconnect()
        end
    end)
end
